integration_decision.finding: Direct inspection of exact test_runner_two_child_spawn_preflight.py shows both Queue.get(timeout=10) except queue.Empty branches call pA/pB.terminate() followed immediately by pytest.fail(), without join() or shared finally cleanup; ctx.Queue is also not explicitly closed/join_thread. Therefore timeout/failure can leave unjoined child resources. This is a test-harness hygiene gap, not evidence of a Capital Flow production race. Current test joins A before starting B and checks only anata_latest.json; cannot establish three-file concurrency safety. runner.py writes latest.json, audit_latest.json, anata_latest.json via separate atomic_write_json calls; storage.py archive lock covers archive read/append only. No new production defect proven.
integration_decision.no_network_contract: On authorized exact-SHA checkout, run existing preflight collect-only/targeted/full suite and preserve stdout, exitcodes, SHA. For future Gemini-owned bounded two-writer regression, use spawn-safe Events; A pauses before third write; rowB PIT-visible and B generation demonstrably distinct via audit/coverage/provenance; inspect all three persisted JSON files. Current-SHA diagnostic may wait for B before releasing A; future serialized-fix acceptance must allow B to wait behind A's lock. Always release Events and terminate+join both children in finally, close+join_thread Queue, assert bounded exitcodes, parse/provenance, and no leaked temporary files. Mixed generations => FAIL; absent interleaving/generation delta/cleanup => INVALID_TEST, not PASS. No sleeps, network, mock handoff, or speculative PASS.
